note: Recorded shapes for modelrack.providers.openai_compatible's conformance and unit tests (spec §19: a provider version bump triggers re-capture and a changelog note). Fixture bodies here are representative payloads matching the documented OpenAI chat-completions wire format that llama.cpp server and LM Studio both implement, not a byte-for-byte capture from a running server — this repository has neither installed. There is no tests/live counterpart for this adapter yet; Phase 4's acceptance criteria are met against these recorded fixtures, the same way Ollama's were before its own live suite existed.
re_annotation_note: ADR-0070 (row C5) added chat_complete_cached.json — a usage object carrying prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, the shape this protocol uses to report cached input and the one the adapter now reconciles into the disjoint input and cache-read classes — and chat_complete_no_usage.json, a well-formed completion with no usage object at all, which is the all-UNSUPPORTED conformance case. chat_stream_no_finish_reason.sse already reaches that same case over the streaming path, where an absent usage chunk arrives as an empty mapping. This is a re-annotation, not a re-capture: no existing payload changed and the representative server version did not move, so spec §19's re-capture trigger did not fire. The two new bodies are representative of the documented OpenAI chat-completions shape on the same terms as the rest of this directory, not captures from a running server.
